title: Gunsmith Cats
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Chicago, gunsmith and expert shooter Rally Vincent runs the Gunsmith Cats gun shop and works as a bounty hunter with her partner Minnie May, a demolitions specialist and former call girl. Joined by teenage ex-burglar Misty, they take on gangsters, the Mafia and the drug-wielding crime boss Goldie Musou in car chases and gunfights.
life_message: Skill, nerve and loyalty to your partners carry you through a criminal underworld.

folkways.japan: A Japanese creator's affectionate, stylized vision of America; Wikipedia notes the setting feels more like a generic American town than Chicago.

delivery.evidence: Reviews cited by Wikipedia praise action and storytelling and mention no moral message (to verify).
delivery.note: An action series that does not argue a worldview; values come through the heroines' choices.

winners_losers: Rally and her partners outmanoeuvre gangsters and the Mafia; sympathy goes to the self-reliant bounty hunters.
